legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.title: Forms or modes of investment or deposits by a registered non-profit organisation
legal_units.text: The modes of investing or depositing the money referred to in section 350 shall be the following:—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1) The modes of investing or depositing the money referred to in section 350 shall be the following:—

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment in savings certificates as defined in section 2(c) of the Government Savings Certificates Act, 1959 (46 of 1959), and any other securities or certificates issued by the Central Government under the Small Savings Schemes of that Government;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (1) investment in savings certificates as defined in section 2(c) of the Government Savings Certificates Act, 1959 (46 of 1959), and any other securities or certificates issued by the Central Government under the Small Savings Schemes of that Government;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: deposit in any account with the Post Office Savings Bank;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (2) deposit in any account with the Post Office Savings Bank;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: deposit in any account with a scheduled bank or a co-operative society engaged in carrying on the business of banking (including a co-operative land mortgage bank or a co-operative land development bank);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (3) deposit in any account with a scheduled bank or a co-operative society engaged in carrying on the business of banking (including a co-operative land mortgage bank or a co-operative land development bank);

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment in units of the Unit Trust of India;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (4) investment in units of the Unit Trust of India;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment in any security for money created and issued by the Central Government or a State Government;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (5) investment in any security for money created and issued by the Central Government or a State Government;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment in debentures issued by, or on behalf of, any company or corporation both the principal whereof and the interest whereon are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the Central Government or by a State Government;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (6) investment in debentures issued by, or on behalf of, any company or corporation both the principal whereof and the interest whereon are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the Central Government or by a State Government;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment or deposit in any public sector company subject to the condition that where an investment or deposit in any public sector company has been made and such public sector company ceases to be a public sector company,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (7) investment or deposit in any public sector company subject to the condition that where an investment or deposit in any public sector company has been made and such public sector company ceases to be a public sector company,—

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: such investment made in the shares of such company shall be deemed to be an investment made under this clause for three years from the date on which such public sector company ceases to be a public sector company;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (7), Clause (a) such investment made in the shares of such company shall be deemed to be an investment made under this clause for three years from the date on which such public sector company ceases to be a public sector company;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: such other investment or deposit shall be deemed to be an investment or deposit made under this clause for the period up to the date on which such investment or deposit becomes repayable by such company;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (7), Clause (b) such other investment or deposit shall be deemed to be an investment or deposit made under this clause for the period up to the date on which such investment or deposit becomes repayable by such company;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: deposits with or investment in any bonds issued by a financial corporation which is engaged in providing long-term finance for industrial development in India and which is eligible for deduction under section 32(e);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (8) deposits with or investment in any bonds issued by a financial corporation which is engaged in providing long-term finance for industrial development in India and which is eligible for deduction under section 32(e);

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: deposits with or investment in any bonds issued by a public company formed and registered in India with the main object of carrying on the business of providing long-term finance for construction or purchase of houses in India for residential purposes and which is eligible for deduction under section 32(e);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (9) deposits with or investment in any bonds issued by a public company formed and registered in India with the main object of carrying on the business of providing long-term finance for construction or purchase of houses in India for residential purposes and which is eligible for deduction under section 32(e);

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: deposits with or investment in any bonds issued by a public company formed and registered in India with the main object of carrying on the business of providing long-term finance for urban infrastructure in India;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (10) deposits with or investment in any bonds issued by a public company formed and registered in India with the main object of carrying on the business of providing long-term finance for urban infrastructure in India;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment in immovable property;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (11) investment in immovable property;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: deposits with the Industrial Development Bank of India established under the Industrial Development Bank of India Act, 1964 (18 of 1964);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (12) deposits with the Industrial Development Bank of India established under the Industrial Development Bank of India Act, 1964 (18 of 1964);

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment in the units issued under any scheme of the mutual fund referred to in Schedule VII (Table: Sl. No. 20) or (Table: Sl. No. 21);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (13) investment in the units issued under any scheme of the mutual fund referred to in Schedule VII (Table: Sl. No. 20) or (Table: Sl. No. 21);

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: any transfer of deposits to the Public Account of India;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (14) any transfer of deposits to the Public Account of India;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: deposits made with an authority constituted in India by or under any law enacted either for the purpose of dealing with and satisfying the need for housing accommodation or for the purpose of planning, development or improvement of cities, towns and villages, or for both;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (15) deposits made with an authority constituted in India by or under any law enacted either for the purpose of dealing with and satisfying the need for housing accommodation or for the purpose of planning, development or improvement of cities, towns and villages, or for both;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment by way of acquiring equity shares of a depository as defined in section 2(1)(e) of the Depositories Act, 1996 (22 of 1996);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (16) investment by way of acquiring equity shares of a depository as defined in section 2(1)(e) of the Depositories Act, 1996 (22 of 1996);

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment made by a recognised stock exchange referred to in section 2(f) of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 (42 of 1956) (herein referred to as investor) in the equity share capital of a company (herein referred to as investee)—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (17) investment made by a recognised stock exchange referred to in section 2(f) of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 (42 of 1956) (herein referred to as investor) in the equity share capital of a company (herein referred to as investee)—

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: which is engaged in dealing with securities or mainly associated with the securities market;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (17), Clause (a) which is engaged in dealing with securities or mainly associated with the securities market;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: whose main object is to acquire the membership of another recognised stock exchange for the sole purpose of facilitating the members of the investor to trade on the said stock exchange through the investee as per the directions or guidelines issued under the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (15 of 1992) by the Securities and Exchange Board of India established under section 3 of that Act; and
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (17), Clause (b) whose main object is to acquire the membership of another recognised stock exchange for the sole purpose of facilitating the members of the investor to trade on the said stock exchange through the investee as per the directions or guidelines issued under the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (15 of 1992) by the Securities and Exchange Board of India established under section 3 of that Act; and

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: in which at least 51% of equity shares are held by the investor and the balance equity shares are held by members of such investor;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (17), Clause (c) in which at least 51% of equity shares are held by the investor and the balance equity shares are held by members of such investor;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment made by a person, authorised under section 4 of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (51 of 2007), in the equity share capital or bonds or debentures of a company—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (18) investment made by a person, authorised under section 4 of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (51 of 2007), in the equity share capital or bonds or debentures of a company—

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: which is engaged in operations of retail payments system or digital payments settlement or similar activities in India and abroad and is approved by the Reserve Bank of India for this purpose; and
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (18), Clause (a) which is engaged in operations of retail payments system or digital payments settlement or similar activities in India and abroad and is approved by the Reserve Bank of India for this purpose; and

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: in which at least 51% of equity shares are held by National Payments Corporation of India;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (18), Clause (b) in which at least 51% of equity shares are held by National Payments Corporation of India;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment made by a person, authorised under section 4 of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (51 of 2007), in the equity share capital or bonds or debentures of Open Network for Digital Commerce Ltd., being a company incorporated under section 7(2) read with section 8(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013), for participating in network based open protocol models which enable digital commerce and interoperable digital payments in India;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (19) investment made by a person, authorised under section 4 of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (51 of 2007), in the equity share capital or bonds or debentures of Open Network for Digital Commerce Ltd., being a company incorporated under section 7(2) read with section 8(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013), for participating in network based open protocol models which enable digital commerce and interoperable digital payments in India;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment by way of acquiring equity shares of an incubatee by an incubator;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (20) investment by way of acquiring equity shares of an incubatee by an incubator;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment by way of acquiring shares of National Skill Development Corporation;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (21) investment by way of acquiring shares of National Skill Development Corporation;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment in debt instruments issued by any infrastructure Finance Company registered with the Reserve Bank of India;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (22) investment in debt instruments issued by any infrastructure Finance Company registered with the Reserve Bank of India;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment in "Stock Certificate" as defined in clause (c) of paragraph 2 of the Sovereign Gold Bonds Scheme, 2015, published in the Official Gazette vide notification number G.S.R. 827(E), dated the 30th October, 2015;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (23) investment in "Stock Certificate" as defined in clause (c) of paragraph 2 of the Sovereign Gold Bonds Scheme, 2015, published in the Official Gazette vide notification number G.S.R. 827(E), dated the 30th October, 2015;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: investment by way of Acquiring Units of Powergrid Infrastructure Investment Trust;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (24) investment by way of Acquiring Units of Powergrid Infrastructure Investment Trust;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: shares in a public sector company;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (25) shares in a public sector company;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: any assets held by the trust or institution where such assets form part of the corpus of the trust or institution as on the 1st June, 1973;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (26) any assets held by the trust or institution where such assets form part of the corpus of the trust or institution as on the 1st June, 1973;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: any asset, being equity shares of a public company, held by any university or other educational institution or any hospital or other medical institution where such assets form part of the corpus of any University or other educational institution or any hospital or other medical institution as on the 1st June, 1998, where it was approved at that time under the provisions of section 10(23C) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 (43 of 1961);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (27) any asset, being equity shares of a public company, held by any university or other educational institution or any hospital or other medical institution where such assets form part of the corpus of any University or other educational institution or any hospital or other medical institution as on the 1st June, 1998, where it was approved at that time under the provisions of section 10(23C) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 (43 of 1961);

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: any accretion to the shares, forming part of the corpus mentioned in sub-paragraph (26) or (27), by way of bonus shares allotted to the trust or institution;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (28) any accretion to the shares, forming part of the corpus mentioned in sub-paragraph (26) or (27), by way of bonus shares allotted to the trust or institution;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: any assets (being debentures issued by, or on behalf of, any company or corporation) acquired by the trust or institution before the 1st March, 1983;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (29) any assets (being debentures issued by, or on behalf of, any company or corporation) acquired by the trust or institution before the 1st March, 1983;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: voluntary contributions received and maintained in the form of jewellery, furniture or any other article as the Board may, by notification specify;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (30) voluntary contributions received and maintained in the form of jewellery, furniture or any other article as the Board may, by notification specify;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: any asset, not being an investment or deposit in any of the forms or modes specified in sub-paragraphs (1) to (30), where such asset is not so held up to one year from the end of the tax year in which such asset is acquired;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (31) any asset, not being an investment or deposit in any of the forms or modes specified in sub-paragraphs (1) to (30), where such asset is not so held up to one year from the end of the tax year in which such asset is acquired;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: any funds representing the profits and gains of business, being profits and gains of any tax year relevant to the tax year commencing on the 1st April, 1984 or any subsequent tax year so, however, where it has any other income in addition to profits and gains of business, these provisions shall not apply unless it maintains separate books of account in respect of such business.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (1), Subparagraph (32) any funds representing the profits and gains of business, being profits and gains of any tax year relevant to the tax year commencing on the 1st April, 1984 or any subsequent tax year so, however, where it has any other income in addition to profits and gains of business, these provisions shall not apply unless it maintains separate books of account in respect of such business.

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this Schedule,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (2) For the purposes of this Schedule,—

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: "long-term finance" means any loan or advance where the terms under which moneys are loaned or advanced provide for repayment along with interest thereof during a period of not less than five years;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (2), Clause (a) "long-term finance" means any loan or advance where the terms under which moneys are loaned or advanced provide for repayment along with interest thereof during a period of not less than five years;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: "public company" shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in section 2(71) of the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (2), Clause (b) "public company" shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in section 2(71) of the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013);

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: "urban infrastructure" means a project for providing potable water supply, sanitation and sewerage, drainage, solid waste management, roads, bridges and flyovers or urban transport;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (2), Clause (c) "urban infrastructure" means a project for providing potable water supply, sanitation and sewerage, drainage, solid waste management, roads, bridges and flyovers or urban transport;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: "immovable property" does not include any machinery or plant (other than machinery or plant installed in a building for the convenient occupation of the building) even though attached to, or permanently fastened to, anything attached to the earth;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (2), Clause (d) "immovable property" does not include any machinery or plant (other than machinery or plant installed in a building for the convenient occupation of the building) even though attached to, or permanently fastened to, anything attached to the earth;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: "incubatee" shall mean such incubatee as may be notified by the Government of India in the Ministry of Science and Technology;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (2), Clause (e) "incubatee" shall mean such incubatee as may be notified by the Government of India in the Ministry of Science and Technology;

legal_units.schedule_title: PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS
legal_units.text: "incubator" shall mean such Technology Business Incubator or Science and Technology Entrepreneurship Park as notified by the Government of India in the Ministry of Science and Technology.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Schedule XVI PERMITTED MODES OF INVESTMENT OR DEPOSITS Schedule XVI, Paragraph (2), Clause (f) "incubator" shall mean such Technology Business Incubator or Science and Technology Entrepreneurship Park as notified by the Government of India in the Ministry of Science and Technology.
